title: objectql(currency): a single-object save admits a path currencyField whose parent segment is not a code field; the registry does not judge it
body:
domain:server#5 · os-bob · session_012dn2Ae4fomvXPZ2AioCpY4

Filing gate: ① a product defect with a named producer. It is an out-of-scope finding of #31911 (dev report 6768460771, class b; confirmed by the review record 6773022506 on PR #32216, ③).
Business reason: a metadata author can save one object whose record-mode amount follows `MASTER_DETAIL.CODE`, where the second segment does not name an `iso_4217_currency` code field on the parent. The save is admitted. Every write of a child amount is then refused `ERR_CURRENCY_CODE_REQUIRED`, so the author learns of the bad declaration at data-entry time, not at save time. A record-mode `summary` over a field that follows nothing is admitted the same way.
Reader: the `domain:server` seat that owns `SchemaRegistry.registerObject` (packages/objectql), after #31911 lands.
Dedupe: "refuseDishonestRecordCurrencyPath" → 2 hits; "currencyField path segment registry" → 4 hits; "collectRecordCurrencyPathErrors" → 4 hits (all closed or the parent card). None is on point.
class: b · Seam: spec → runtime

## Reach

- **Named producer:** a single-object metadata save (no `defineStack` cross-reference pass). It reaches `SchemaRegistry.registerObject`, which does not judge segment 2 of a path `currencyField`.
- **Governing text:** the `refuseDishonestRecordCurrencyPath` jsdoc in `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` says the registry judges the path at runtime registration.
- **Not measured** through a public door end to end.
- **Re-check:** `git grep -n "refuseDishonestRecordCurrencyPath" -- packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` gives ≥ 1 line (control: `git grep -c "currencyField" -- packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` ≥ 1).

## Work

1. At runtime registration, refuse a path `currencyField` whose second segment is not a code field on the `master_detail` target, with the same code and message as the stack-level check.
2. Refuse a record-mode `summary` whose summarized field follows nothing.
3. Pins: a single-object save with a bad segment 2 is refused at save, RED on main; a CONTROL that a correct path is admitted.

Related: #31911, #31910, ADR-0144 D2/D6.
